detail.longDescription: Everywhere I look, I see news about AI agents doing stuff. On Hackernews, it's people asking questions on how to improve their AI agents or what more AI agents can do with them. AI agents seem to be all the rage these days. I'm getting into AI security but right now my skills are just focused on prompt injection. How do I learn agentic AI security? Do free/budget-friendly labs or CTFs exist or will I have to build everything from scratch? (which I'm totally fine with doing, by the way). # aisecurity # agenticai # security # infosec # cybersecurity # ctfs
